subject: [hw] DONE V40: /dev/vcu device model + AP-side API, 373 checks x 3 builds
body:
DONE V40 (the /dev/vcu device model: the Linux mtk_vcu ioctl/mmap ABI in user space over n2vc_hw). Host-tested only; no phone, nothing published, nothing committed.

Last line of bash gpu/hwcodec/vcu/test_v40/run_tests.sh:
    N2TEST V40 PASS 1119/1119
(three builds of the same 373 checks: -O1 -g -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all, plain -O2, and -fsanitize=thread -O1 -g; -std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -Werror; each run prints "SUMMARY 373 373"; about 5 s; artifacts only under /tmp/n2hw-V40, 4.5 MB.)
Extra check: bash gpu/hwcodec/vcu/test_v40/compile_ios.sh -> N2TEST V40-IOS PASS 1/1 (arm64-apple-ios16.5, compile only).

Delivered (gpu/hwcodec/vcu/{n2vcu.c,n2vcu.h,mtk_vcu_abi.h,STATUS.md}, vcu/test_v40/{t_v40.c,layout_probe.c,probe_extract.py,run_tests.sh,compile_ios.sh}, dsh-state/workers/V40/STATUS.md):

- mtk_vcu_abi.h (GPL-2.0): the 32-bit AAPCS ABI of include/uapi/linux/mtk_vcu_controls.h, _Static_assert on every size/offset/request. mem_obj 0x20, map_obj 0x10, gce_cmds 0xe808 (addr 0x800, data 0x4800, mask 0x8800, dma_offset 0xa800, dma_size 0xc800, cmd_cnt 0xe800), gce_cmdq_obj 0x20, gce_obj 0x10, share_obj 0x58, log_test_nofuse 0x400; SET_OBJECT 0x40587600, MVA_ALLOC 0xc0207601, MVA_FREE 0xc0207602, CACHE_* 0xc0207603-05, PA_ALLOC 0xc0207606, PA_FREE 0xc0207607, GCE_FLUSH 0x40207608, GCE_WAIT 0x40107609, GET_OBJECT 0xc058760a, GET_LOG 0x4400760b, SET_MMAP_TYPE 0x4010760d. Oracle: the kernel header itself compiled with clang --target=armv7a-linux-gnueabi (layout_probe.c -> probe_values.h, regenerated each run), checked three ways (probe vs header vs test literals). Mutation-checked: moving the VENC window base by 4 bytes fails 16 checks; changing a request number trips a static assert.
- n2vcu.c: /dev/vcu and /dev/vpu n2vfs_devs over n2vc_hw. SET/GET_OBJECT (two instance slots, ipi_done at GET entry, stop_request/-EINTR, bounded timeout), MVA/PA allocation and free (hw->dma_alloc, n2vc_dma_guest_map, field-by-field free matching of mtk_vcodec_mem.c, -1 fields on failure, 512-buffer cap, last close frees all), CACHE_* (n2vc_dma_sync, vb2 buffers only as in the kernel), GCE_SET_CMD_FLUSH (CMD_READ/WRITE/POLL_REG/WAIT_EVENT/MEM_MV/POLL_ADDR plus SEC_WRITE/unknown skip; rwvc_reg_op batches in command order; wait-for-event -> hw->wait_irq with the event-class-to-IRQ mapping; bad addresses skipped and counted as vcu_set_gce_cmd does; cmd_cnt clamp + EINVAL; codec/core validation), GCE_WAIT_CALLBACK, SET_MMAP_TYPE, GET/SET_LOG_OBJECT, and mmap (the three VCU windows -> guest MMIO megabytes whose hooks call hw->regs, sub-word and unaligned accesses defined; MAP_SHMEM_ALLOC/COMMIT -> the 0x80000 DMEM; MAP_SHMEM_MM*/PA_BASE/bare pa -> the DMA buffer guest mapping).
- n2vcu.h: n2vcu_create(mem,hw), destroy, dev/dev_vpu accessors, ap_register/ap_send/ap_pending/ap_wait_dispatched, map_dm_addr/dmem, timeout setters, set_gce_threads, abort, stats.

Interface answers already posted to hw-v41 (slot ordering, ipi_done = GET entry, n2vc_dma_guest_map has no pa so n2vcu keeps its own pa/guest/bytes table) and hw-iv (create does not register; call n2vfs_register(n2vcu_dev(vcu)) and n2vfs_register(n2vcu_dev_vpu(vcu)); nothing to reserve; M-c evidence from n2vcu_stats(), the model never prints).

Not done / deliberate deviations (all in vcu/STATUS.md): every wait is bounded (kernel blocks forever) -> -ETIMEDOUT; GCE lists execute synchronously and return their first hardware error instead of using the async callback; an address inside a VCU window but outside any RWVC_WIN_* window is skipped and counted; mem_obj returns iova=pa=hardware address and va=guest mapping (superset of the kernel); SET_OBJECT clamps len to 80; SET_MMAP_TYPE returns 0 (kernel: -1/EPERM); log ioctls do not block and clamp to the _IOC size (struct log_test does not exist in the tree); the DMEM mmap honours the in-range offset; mmap also accepts a bare pa/iova; no unregister (n2a32_mem has no unmap, so destroy last); CMD_SEC_WRITE skipped; a bad guest pointer stays a guest fault, not -EFAULT. Open: CMDQ POLL value/mask semantics (the frozen RWVC ABI masks both sides), and the two computed vendor mmap offsets (D01 8.6) are still unknown. No phone run, no performance numbers.
Available for review findings.
